name: Q&A topic hub
definition: Closing grid of topic cards, each with a cue (“If asked …”) and a link to the slide that answers it.
bestUse: Q&A sessions, so likely questions are answered with existing slides.

demo.how: The closing slide is a grid of likely questions, each with an “If asked…” cue and the backup slide that answers it. Choose a card to jump to that slide, then press Back to topics to return; visited cards get a check so the presenter sees what is already covered.
